item.title: Samsung accidentally freezes its smart fridges with a software update
item.description:
📝 Now, we can add another Samsung smart refrigerator issue to the list. Samsung has stopped rolling out a SmartThings update to its smart refrigerators in Korea after some owners reported major issues, ZDNET Korea reports. The fact that this issue apparently occurred while Samsung was testing a software update for the fridges is very concerning.
